newsitem.title: USA: Nematron sees lower near term earnings.
newsitem.headline: Nematron sees lower near term earnings.

text.p: Nematron Corp said Monday it expects increased product development and sales force investments to lower near term earnings.

The company, which makes PC-based industrial automation products, said revenues from hardware products will be flat in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 compared to a year ago because of a near-term market softening.
Software revenues are expected to increase in fiscal 1997 after the release of the Hyperkernel and Open Control software products in the fiscal second quarter.

Although spending on those two products is expected to hurt near-term profits, the company said in a statement that most of its future growth in revenue and earnings will come from those product areas.
Nematron on Monday posted fiscal fourth quarter net income of $217,500, up from $165,500 a year ago. Revenues for the quarter were $5.7 million, up from $4.5 million.
